name: LBS
summary: LBS (London Breakout Strategy) is an Expert Advisor designed to trade the London session open breakout. It identifies a narrow Asian session consolidation range and enters trades when price breaks above or below that range during the London session, capturing momentum-driven directional moves.
summary_zh: LBS（伦敦突破策略）是一个专为交易伦敦时段开盘突破而设计的EA。它识别亚洲时段的窄幅整理区间，并在伦敦时段价格突破该区间时入场交易，捕捉动量驱动的方向性走势。
strategy_analysis: LBS策略的核心概念是利用亚洲时段（东京时段）形成的窄幅整理区间作为参考，在伦敦开盘后价格突破该区间时入场做多或做空。入场条件为：价格突破亚洲区间上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于典型的时段突破策略。出场条件包括固定止盈目标、固定止损以及伦敦时段结束前强制平仓，避免隔夜风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置但未发现严格的资金比例控制或动态仓位调整机制，止损与止盈的比例相对固定。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the LBS strategy is to use the narrow consolidation range formed during the Asian (Tokyo) session as a reference, entering long or short when price breaks out of that range after the London session opens. Entry conditions are: go long when price breaks above the Asian range high, go short when price breaks below the Asian range low — a classic session breakout approach. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit targets, fixed stop-loss levels, and forced closing before the end of the London session to avoid overnight risk. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-of-balance calculation; no martingale or grid pyramiding logic was found. Money management provides stop-loss settings but lacks strict equity percentage controls or dynamic position adjustment; the stop-loss to take-profit ratio is relatively fixed.

parameters.description_en: Asian session end time (before London open)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for trade identification

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于成熟的伦敦开盘突破概念，易于理解和验证
具有时段过滤机制，避免在低流动性时段交易，减少假突破风险
伦敦时段结束前强制平仓，避免隔夜跳空风险，资金安全性较好
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the well-established London open breakout concept, easy to understand and validate
Session filter mechanism avoids trading during low-liquidity periods, reducing false breakout risk
Forced closing before London session end avoids overnight gap risk, enhancing capital safety
cons: 未包含点差过滤，伦敦开盘时点差可能扩大导致滑点损失
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑不同货币对的波动率差异，适应性不足
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
亚洲区间识别方法简单，未考虑区间过宽时的假突破概率增加问题
cons_en: No spread filter included; spreads may widen at London open causing slippage losses
Fixed pip values for stop-loss and take-profit do not account for volatility differences across currency pairs, limiting adaptability
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar leading to overtrading
Simple Asian range identification without considering increased false breakout probability when the range is too wide
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离，提高策略适应性
添加点差过滤和新K线检查，防止在点差过大时入场和同一K线重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility, improving strategy adaptability
Add spread filter and new bar check to prevent entries during high spread conditions and duplicate positions on the same bar

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，伦敦开盘时点差扩大可能导致入场价格不利
固定止损止盈未考虑波动率，低波动货币对可能止损过宽而高波动货币对止损过窄
未发现严格的持仓检查机制，存在重复开仓的潜在风险
risk_points_en: Lack of spread filter may result in unfavorable entry prices when spreads widen at London open
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit ignore volatility; stop may be too wide for low-volatility pairs and too narrow for high-volatility pairs
No strict position check mechanism found, posing potential risk of duplicate position opening

It identifies a narrow Asian session consolidation range and enters trades when price breaks above or below that range during the London session, capturing momentum-driven directional moves.
